name: When should a construction site evaluation be performed?

mainEntity.name: When should a construction site evaluation be performed?

acceptedAnswer.text: A construction site evaluation should ideally be performed early in the project timeline, typically before architectural design begins in earnest, or even before purchasing a lot. This allows potential site challenges to be identified and addressed proactively, influencing design choices, budget estimates, and overall project feasibility. Early evaluation helps prevent redesigns and delays later on.
acceptedAnswer.description: It should be performed early, ideally before architectural design or lot purchase, to identify challenges and influence project feasibility.
